test_healthcheck: test the healthcheck endpoint by polling /healthcheck and verifying a 200 status with 'ok' in the response body
test_poll: test the poll utility function that retries HTTP GET requests until an expected status code or condition is met
test_get: test the get utility function that sends HTTP GET requests to a specified URL with optional headers
test_post: test the post utility function that sends HTTP POST requests with optional JSON payload and headers
test_post_refresh: test the post_refresh function that sends a webhook update event for a given dataset
